changeSet.sql: insert into student_course (student_standard_id, course_id, created_by, created_date) select ss.id, c.id, 'System', ss.created_date FROM student_standard as ss inner join standard as s on ss.standard_id=s.id inner join course as c on (c.grade=s.grade and c.school_info_id=s.school_info_id) where ss.active=true and c.course_type='SCHOLASTIC' and c.mandatory=true order by ss.id;
